document.title: Wiring two agents together
document.excerpt: We connected a planner and an executor over A2A: the planner publishes an agent card, the executor discovers it and they exchange tasks as JSON-RPC messages. Compared with a custom HTTP API, A2A gave us discovery and streaming for free.

document.title: LLM judges drift
document.excerpt: We re-ran the same judge prompt over 1,000 answers a month apart and saw 8% of verdicts flip. Pinning the judge model and keeping a holdout set made the drift measurable.
